purpose: Original illustrative restaurant images, regenerated with natural photographic lighting and food texture.

prompts.prompt: Redo this image as a genuinely believable unretouched photograph, not an idealized food render. Keep the type of food, but restyle and recompose freely to make it hyper-realistic. Natural ordinary daylight in an actual working eatery, neutral white balance, restrained true-to-life color. Avoid the previous sepia warmth, repeated textures, artificial glow, immaculate styling, giant portions and smooth CGI surfaces. Physically accurate small-scale food texture, subtle natural irregularities, believable soft highlights and shadows, imperfect asymmetry, tiny incidental crumbs, real surfaces. A candid but well-composed photograph from a good camera, 50mm lens, f/5.6, ISO400, no artificial shallow blur, no HDR, no fake film grain. Landscape 3:2. No text, no logo, no hands. A normal portion of Caribbean grilled chicken and fries in a simple cream ceramic dinner plate on a clean worn cafe tabletop, one chicken fillet cut into uneven pieces showing moist pale interior and lightly charred exterior; modest pasta salad and pickled onion beside it. Small practical condiment cups. Food genuinely looks cooked by a person. Some pieces overlap naturally. Less elaborate than the reference, more everyday, still delicious.
